প্রদত্ত সমীকরণ: y=1−cos⁡x1−sin⁡xy = \dfrac{1 - \cos x}{1 - \sin x}y=1−sinx1−cosx​
নির্ণেয়: dydx\dfrac{dy}{dx}dxdy​
📘 English Note — Trigonometric Quotient Formulation
The problem consists of sinusoidal trigonometric expressions in numerator and denominator: y=u(x)v(x),where u(x)=1−cos⁡x,  v(x)=1−sin⁡xy = \frac{u(x)}{v(x)}, \quad \text{where } u(x) = 1 - \cos x, \; v(x) = 1 - \sin xy=v(x)u(x)​,where u(x)=1−cosx,v(x)=1−sinx Applying the fundamental Quotient Rule and Pythagorean identity sin⁡2x+cos⁡2x=1\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x = 1sin2x+cos2x=1: ddx(uv)=vdudx−udvdxv2,with dudx=sin⁡x,  dvdx=−cos⁡x\frac{d}{dx}\left(\frac{u}{v}\right) = \frac{v \frac{du}{dx} - u \frac{dv}{dx}}{v^2}, \quad \text{with } \frac{du}{dx} = \sin x, \; \frac{dv}{dx} = -\cos xdxd​(vu​)=v2vdxdu​−udxdv​​,with dxdu​=sinx,dxdv​=−cosx
১. গাণিতিক কাঠামো ও প্রয়োজনীয় সূত্রসমূহ
উপাদান (Component) ফাংশন রূপ প্রমিত অন্তরজ সূত্র (Standard Derivative)
লব (uuu) 1−cos⁡x1 - \cos x1−cosx ddx(1−cos⁡x)=0−(−sin⁡x)=sin⁡x\dfrac{d}{dx}(1 - \cos x) = 0 - (-\sin x) = \sin xdxd​(1−cosx)=0−(−sinx)=sinx
হর (vvv) 1−sin⁡x1 - \sin x1−sinx ddx(1−sin⁡x)=0−cos⁡x=−cos⁡x\dfrac{d}{dx}(1 - \sin x) = 0 - \cos x = -\cos xdxd​(1−sinx)=0−cosx=−cosx
হরের বর্গ (v2v^2v2) (1−sin⁡x)2(1 - \sin x)^2(1−sinx)2 (1−sin⁡x)2(1 - \sin x)^2(1−sinx)2 (উৎপাদক আকারেই রাখা সমীচীন)
পিথাগোরাসের অভেদ sin⁡2x+cos⁡2x=1\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x = 1sin2x+cos2x=1 −sin⁡2x−cos⁡2x=−(sin⁡2x+cos⁡2x)=−1-\sin^2 x - \cos^2 x = -(\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x) = -1−sin2x−cos2x=−(sin2x+cos2x)=−1
⚠️ English Note — Critical AMIE Exam Traps & Pitfalls
1. Double Negative Sign Errors: Note that ddx(1−cos⁡x)=+sin⁡x\frac{d}{dx}(1-\cos x) = \mathbf{+\sin x}dxd​(1−cosx)=+sinx and ddx(1−sin⁡x)=−cos⁡x\frac{d}{dx}(1-\sin x) = \mathbf{-\cos x}dxd​(1−sinx)=−cosx.
2. Distribution of Negative Sign: Carefully evaluate: −(1−cos⁡x)(−cos⁡x)=−(−cos⁡x+cos⁡2x)=+cos⁡x−cos⁡2x-(1 - \cos x)(-\cos x) = -(-\cos x + \cos^2 x) = \mathbf{+\cos x - \cos^2 x}−(1−cosx)(−cosx)=−(−cosx+cos2x)=+cosx−cos2x Mixing signs leads to an invalid +1+1+1 in numerator instead of −1-1−1.
২. ধাপে ধাপে পূর্ণাঙ্গ সমাধান (Step-by-Step Solution)
ধাপ ১:
উভয় পক্ষে xxx-এর সাপেক্ষে অন্তরীকরণ অপারেটর প্রয়োগ করে:
dydx=ddx(1−cos⁡x1−sin⁡x)\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{d}{dx}\left(\frac{1 - \cos x}{1 - \sin x}\right)dxdy​=dxd​(1−sinx1−cosx​)
ধাপ ২:
ভাগফলের সূত্র (Quotient Rule) অনুসারে সাজানো:
dydx=(1−sin⁡x)ddx(1−cos⁡x)−(1−cos⁡x)ddx(1−sin⁡x)(1−sin⁡x)2\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{(1 - \sin x)\frac{d}{dx}(1 - \cos x) - (1 - \cos x)\frac{d}{dx}(1 - \sin x)}{(1 - \sin x)^2}dxdy​=(1−sinx)2(1−sinx)dxd​(1−cosx)−(1−cosx)dxd​(1−sinx)​
ধাপ ৩:
প্রমিত অন্তরজের মান dudx=sin⁡x\frac{du}{dx} = \sin xdxdu​=sinx এবং dvdx=−cos⁡x\frac{dv}{dx} = -\cos xdxdv​=−cosx বসিয়ে:
dydx=(1−sin⁡x)(sin⁡x)−(1−cos⁡x)(−cos⁡x)(1−sin⁡x)2\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{(1 - \sin x)(\sin x) - (1 - \cos x)(-\cos x)}{(1 - \sin x)^2}dxdy​=(1−sinx)2(1−sinx)(sinx)−(1−cosx)(−cosx)​

ধাপ ৪:
লবের বন্ধনী বিস্তার ও পদ পুনর্বিন্যাস:
dydx=sin⁡x−sin⁡2x−(−cos⁡x+cos⁡2x)(1−sin⁡x)2=sin⁡x−sin⁡2x+cos⁡x−cos⁡2x(1−sin⁡x)2\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{\sin x - \sin^2 x - (-\cos x + \cos^2 x)}{(1 - \sin x)^2} = \frac{\sin x - \sin^2 x + \cos x - \cos^2 x}{(1 - \sin x)^2}dxdy​=(1−sinx)2sinx−sin2x−(−cosx+cos2x)​=(1−sinx)2sinx−sin2x+cosx−cos2x​
dydx=sin⁡x+cos⁡x−(sin⁡2x+cos⁡2x)(1−sin⁡x)2\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{\sin x + \cos x - (\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x)}{(1 - \sin x)^2}dxdy​=(1−sinx)2sinx+cosx−(sin2x+cos2x)​
ধাপ ৫:
পিথাগোরাসের অভেদ sin⁡2x+cos⁡2x=1\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x = 1sin2x+cos2x=1 প্রয়োগ করে চূড়ান্ত উত্তর:
dydx=sin⁡x+cos⁡x−1(1−sin⁡x)2\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{\sin x + \cos x - 1}{(1 - \sin x)^2}dxdy​=(1−sinx)2sinx+cosx−1​
চূড়ান্ত উত্তর (Final Standard Answer)
dydx=sin⁡x+cos⁡x−1(1−sin⁡x)2\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{\sin x + \cos x - 1}{(1 - \sin x)^2}dxdy​=(1−sinx)2sinx+cosx−1​
🔬 English Note — Singularities & Domain of Differentiability
  • Domain of Function & Derivative: Non-zero denominator requires 1−sin⁡x≠0  ⟹  sin⁡x≠11 - \sin x \neq 0 \implies \sin x \neq 11−sinx=0⟹sinx=1. Thus, x≠2kπ+π2,  k∈Zx \neq 2k\pi + \frac{\pi}{2}, \; k \in \mathbb{Z}x=2kπ+2π​,k∈Z. Dom(y)=Dom(dydx)=R∖{2kπ+π2  |  k∈Z}\text{Dom}(y) = \text{Dom}\left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right) = \mathbb{R} \setminus \left\{ 2k\pi + \frac{\pi}{2} \;\middle|\; k \in \mathbb{Z} \right\}Dom(y)=Dom(dxdy​)=R∖{2kπ+2π​​k∈Z}
  • Singularities: At points x=π2,5π2,…x = \frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{5\pi}{2}, \dotsx=2π​,25π​,…, the function and its derivative possess vertical infinite asymptotes.
💡 English Note — Alternative Partial Quotient Form
The numerator can also be split as −(1−sin⁡x)+cos⁡x-(1 - \sin x) + \cos x−(1−sinx)+cosx: dydx=−(1−sin⁡x)+cos⁡x(1−sin⁡x)2=−11−sin⁡x+cos⁡x(1−sin⁡x)2\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{-(1 - \sin x) + \cos x}{(1 - \sin x)^2} = -\frac{1}{1 - \sin x} + \frac{\cos x}{(1 - \sin x)^2}dxdy​=(1−sinx)2−(1−sinx)+cosx​=−1−sinx1​+(1−sinx)2cosx​ The closed form sin⁡x+cos⁡x−1(1−sin⁡x)2\frac{\sin x + \cos x - 1}{(1 - \sin x)^2}(1−sinx)2sinx+cosx−1​ is standard in AMIE textbook marking keys.
